steps.name: When the admin opens the Edit category modal
And the admin enters 0 characters into the "Опис" field
Then the Team category "Опис" value should be "" with the correct counter
When the admin appends "a" to the "Опис" field
Then the Team category "Опис" value should be "a" with the correct counter
When the admin appends "b" to the "Опис" field
Then the Team category "Опис" value should be "ab" with the correct counter
When the admin appends "c" to the "Опис" field
Then the Team category "Опис" value should be "abc" with the correct counter
When the admin removes the last character from the "Опис" field
Then the Team category "Опис" value should be "ab" with the correct counter
When the admin removes the last character from the "Опис" field
Then the Team category "Опис" value should be "a" with the correct counter
